why_lead: ROOT selected from own-date retail headline: 150% Q3 profit/revenue breakout plus explicit soaring retail sentiment; no unverified stock quote added.

why_smaller.title: Nvidia / NVDA — the establishment adopts the AI winner
why_smaller.selection_evidence: The New York Times reported that Nvidia would replace Intel in the Dow Jones index, and CNBC also covered the coming change.[[n3273]][[n3742]] For a retail investor, index inclusion is an emotionally satisfying stamp of recognition: the AI story has reached an established market institution. Nvidia closed at USD 135.40, up +8.39% over 20 sessions but down -4.34% over five sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-01). Recognition arrives against an uneven recent tape, which makes it a catalyst to assess rather than a guarantee of another uninterrupted rise.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: the establishment adopts the AI winner

why_smaller.title: Gold / GLD — election anxiety needs no earnings forecast
why_smaller.selection_evidence: South China Morning Post asked why Chinese buyers were rushing for gold despite record prices, while Reuters connected gold's record high to global political uncertainty.[[n0752]][[n4556]] That is a different emotional purchase from an earnings breakout: the holder wants protection from outcomes that cannot be modelled with confidence. GLD closed at USD 252.47, up +3.05% over 20 sessions but down -0.34% over five sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-01). The fund offers a straightforward gold-price expression without the operating risks of an individual miner, although it remains a market-priced asset that can fall.
why_smaller.narrative_distinction: election anxiety needs no earnings forecast

why_smaller.title: Trump Media / DJT — the political trade loses altitude
why_smaller.selection_evidence: Fortune described a sudden crash in DJT that erased USD 2.4 billion of Trump's wealth in three days.[[n3280]] The changed feature is the severity of the reversal: the shares closed at USD 30.56, down -21.54% over five sessions despite remaining up +85.21% over 20 sessions (Yahoo Finance, prior close 2024-11-01). A supporter can still see a bargain; a trader sees how quickly an identity-driven advance can surrender its gains.

DJT: fresh crash coverage, demoted to brief update after Nov 1 lead.
